title: Recognition and program cost
hook: Two stated cases: explore the cost denominator in a reward comparison.

doesNotKnow: How the cost denominator in a reward comparison affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Saving, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the cost denominator in a reward comparison in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
